articles.title: Ripple-linked XRP sinks 7% to four-month lows
articles.snippet: XRP fell another 7% after losing key support levels, with traders weighing growing institutional demand against one of the token's weakest technical setups in months.

articles.title: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP ETFs bleed $4.4 billion over 13 sessions, only HYPE in green
articles.snippet: BlackRock's IBIT shed another $342 million on Wednesday as ether, solana and XRP funds joined the redemption wave, leaving Hyperliquid's HYPE products as the only major crypto ETF category still pulling in net new money.

articles.title: Bitmine eyes dividend-paying preferred shares, echoing Strategy’s playbook
articles.snippet: The move comes as Ether prices slumped to a 14-month low below $1,750 on Thursday.

articles.title: As Oil Moves Higher, Bitcoin Sinks to Lowest Price Since March
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to a more than two-month low alongside U.S. stocks after Middle East skirmishes pushed bond yields and oil prices higher.
